_comment: Cross-driver updater scalars and release artifact names. Single source replacing per-file literals in lib/updater/core.ahk, lib/updater.lua, the Linux updater, and release CI. AHK keeps inline scalars guarded by the JS drift gate; macOS and Linux read this file at require-time via Paths.shared. Interval presets stay driver-specific (identical values, complex TOML array-of-tables not worth a custom parser). release_sources: URL templates ({owner}/{repo}) and budgets of the changelog window, which tries the REST API first and the public Atom feed when the API is blocked or slow; ui_watchdog_sec must exceed proxy_resolve_timeout_sec + 2 * source_timeout_sec.
